title: finding(console/collaboration): two more date faces format with the UI language instead of `useDisplayLocale()` — the approvals inbox's >30-day date and `CommentThread`'s >7-day absolute timestamp
body:
Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (seat 1, session `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`) from objectui#10331's dev report (PR objectui#10369, `out_of_scope_findings`: two class-b entries, filed as one card as the dev suggested). ⛔ Not graded and not routed: `domain:*`, `priority:*` and `type` are the triage seat's.

## Fact

The display-locale contract in `packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts` says: 「Every date, number and currency renderer goes through here for exactly that reason.」 objectui#10331 moved three console faces onto it. Two more faces, which the objectui#9909 census does not judge because they pass an expression argument, still format with the UI language:

1. `apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`: `formatRelative`'s bucket for items older than 30 days runs `new Date(s).toLocaleDateString(language)` (`:741` at `origin/main`), with `language` from `useObjectTranslation()`.
2. `packages/collaboration/src/CommentThread.tsx`: `formatAbsoluteDate(date, language)` (`:79`, called at `:116` for comments older than 7 days) runs `date.toLocaleDateString(language)`, with `language` from `useCollaborationTranslation()`. That function's doc comment chose 「the session language」 under objectui#3441, before the display-locale contract existed.

The seat read both sites on `origin/main`.

## Measured

This is the same mechanism objectui#10369's ablation measured on its three faces: with an English UI and a `de-CH` display locale, passing the UI language renders the `en` form (`3/4/2020`, not `4.3.2020`). ⛔ These two faces were read, not probed.

## Seam

`i18n:useDisplayLocale` doc contract → `console:ApprovalsInboxPage` `formatRelative` · `collaboration:CommentThread` `formatTimestamp` / `formatAbsoluteDate`.

## ⛔ Not claimed

- ⛔ No fix is chosen here. The objectui#10331 shape (read `useDisplayLocale()` at the component or hook, with no fallback) is the obvious one.
- ⚠️ The census `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts` has a DECLARED entry for `CommentThread.tsx` (`:232`, `:367`) that is its lit control. A fix must keep that control's entry true, or retarget it on purpose.
- Once both faces land, the census's bare-`language` extension, costed in objectui#10369's PR body, is cheap and closes the class.

## Dedupe words

`ApprovalsInboxPage formatRelative toLocaleDateString language` · `CommentThread formatAbsoluteDate language` · `approvals inbox date display locale` · `comment timestamp display locale`
